message.content:
I'm debugging an "Auth session missing" error report in a Next.js + Supabase app at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu. The user said (in Indonesian): "belum ada 1 menit saya ketik pasword baru dan lama sudah auth session missing" — roughly "within less than a minute of typing new and old password, [I got] auth session missing".

I already know about and just fixed `src/app/reset-password/page.tsx` (the public password-recovery flow reached via a "lupa password" email link) — that page only has "Password Baru" and "Ulangi Password" fields, NO "old/current password" field, since it's a recovery-token-based flow.

The user's mention of typing "password baru DAN LAMA" (new AND old password) suggests they might be somewhere else — possibly a "change password while logged in" feature in account/business settings that asks for current password + new password, which would be a completely different code path with its own possible causes for "Auth session missing".

Please search this codebase (particularly under src/app/business/*/settings/, src/app/dashboard/, src/app/account/, or anywhere else plausible) for:
1. Any page/component that has BOTH a "current/old password" field AND a "new password" field in the same form (search for Indonesian terms like "Password Lama", "Password Saat Ini", "Ganti Password", "Ubah Password", as well as English "current password", "old password").
2. Any call to `supabase.auth.updateUser` or `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword` or similar auth methods outside of src/app/reset-password/page.tsx and src/app/forgot-password/page.tsx.
3. Report back: does such a "change password" feature exist elsewhere in this app? If yes, give me the exact file path(s), and show me the full relevant component code (especially the submit handler) so I can diagnose why it might throw "Auth session missing". If no such feature exists anywhere else in the codebase, say so clearly and list what password-related pages DO exist (just reset-password and forgot-password?).

Also check: does `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` or any auth config have anything unusual about session persistence, cookie domain, or session timeout that could cause a freshly-established session to disappear within under a minute?

This is research only — I will do the actual fix myself. Report back concisely with file paths and relevant code, under 400 words if possible.

content.text: Confirmed: those two other files ("password" hits) are unrelated — `add-cashier-form.tsx` and `void-ticket-transaction-form.tsx` use "password" only in incidental context (creating a cashier auth account / PIN-style confirmation for voiding a transaction), not a "change my own password" feature. No file matched any of the Indonesian/English "current/old password" terms anywhere in `src/`.

## Findings

**No "change password while logged in" feature exists anywhere in the codebase.** I searched all of `src/` for Indonesian terms ("Password Lama", "Password Saat Ini", "Ganti Password", "Ubah Password") and English ("current password", "old password", "currentPassword", "oldPassword") — zero matches. I also grepped every `supabase.auth.*` call site: only `src/app/reset-password/page.tsx` (`updateUser`) and `src/app/login/page.tsx` (`signInWithPassword`) touch auth directly.

**Password-related pages that DO exist**, all confirmed by reading their code:
- `src/app/login/page.tsx` — email + password, `signInWithPassword`
- `src/app/signup/page.tsx` — registration (has "password" per grep, not read in full but no old-password field per the broader search)
- `src/app/forgot-password/page.tsx` — sends recovery email
- `src/app/reset-password/page.tsx` — the one you already fixed; only "Password Baru" + "Ulangi Password" (`updateUser({ password })`), no old-password field, confirmed above
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/cashiers/reset-pin-form.tsx` — a cashier PIN reset (not account password)
- `add-cashier-form.tsx` and `void-ticket-transaction-form.tsx` — incidental "password" text hits, unrelated to account password change

The `settings/` directory under `business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/` is business config (tax, printers, payment methods, ticket categories) — no account/password form there. No `src/app/account/` or `src/app/**/profile/` directory exists at all.

**Conclusion:** the user's "password baru dan lama" ("new and old") almost certainly just refers colloquially to typing the new password twice in the confirm field on `reset-password/page.tsx` (or possibly confusion/mistranslation), not a separate settings flow — since no such flow exists in this app.

**Session config** (`src/lib/supabase/client.ts`): plain `createBrowserClient` from `@supabase/ssr`, no custom `auth` options (no `persistSession`, `autoRefreshToken`, storage, or cookie-domain overrides) — defaults apply, nothing unusual there.

**Middleware** (`src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`): has a detailed comment explaining `/reset-password` is deliberately excluded from the auth-gate because the recovery link's `access_token` arrives in the URL fragment and is only readable client-side by supabase-js — "belum ada sesi/cookie sama sekali saat request pertama ini sampai ke middleware." That's the most likely root cause area for the "Auth session missing" report (fragment-based token race/timing before the client establishes the session), consistent with what you already fixed.
